meta.title: Carroll County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Carroll County's 2026 budget, adopted by Ordinance 2025-36 on December 16, 2025. We use the '2026 Budget' column of each office's budget pages, and the total matches the ordinance's total projected expenditures of $16,494,815.36. The ordinance also moves $3,770,941.72 between county funds (for example $2,500,000 of sales tax to the jail fund); that money is counted once, in the fund that spends it.

nodes.name: General Fund
nodes.note: Fund total is the ordinance's 'Total Projected Expenditures' for the General Fund (Section 5, p. 1, scanned).
